name: Docebo
tagline: AI-powered learning platform that personalizes employee development
description: Docebo is an enterprise learning management system powered by AI that personalizes the learning experience for every employee. Its AI features include auto-tagging content, personalized learning recommendations, skill gap analysis, virtual coaching, and AI-generated content. Docebo's deep learning algorithms match employees with relevant courses based on their role, skills, and career goals.
